as_told.title: Psionic assets rounded up for black aerospace programs

plain: A former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he helped retrieve a UFO, states that there are operations outside the continental United States where people search for "psionic assets," meaning people said to have psychic abilities, and that such people are highly prized. A UFO researcher named Steven Greer tells a similar story but calls it trafficking: he places it in Indonesia and says the people were moved to secret sites to be screened and tested. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats Barber's words on several episodes, and once describes these people being rounded up in disaster zones, sometimes in ways that were not ethical. If true, it would mean someone is quietly gathering people with unusual mental gifts.
